predictions.P1 coverage: of the quantities the framework certifies with a rate, the exact value lies inside the certified interval for at least 90% (MEDIUM)
predictions.P2 GCI below: conventional GCI covers a smaller fraction of what it certifies than the framework does (MEDIUM)
predictions.P3 GCI misses: GCI certifies at least 3 quantities whose interval misses the exact value (LOW-MEDIUM)
predictions.P4 peaks: no peak_von_mises is certified, by either method (HIGH)
predictions.P5 conservative: the framework's median effectivity is at most 0.5 (MEDIUM)
predictions.P6 liveness: the framework certifies at least half of the 128 verifiable quantities (LOW-MEDIUM: quadratic elements on singular corners often end pre-asymptotic or band-only)
